blocks.text: In synthesis, the target molecule is prepared starting from simple commercially available compounds. It may involve many steps or transformations to reach the final target molecule. For example, primary aliphatic amine can be prepared in a single step by treating a haloalkane with ammonia.
Since haloalkane is not easily available rather it is prepared from an alcohol which is more easily available as a starting material. The synthesis of an alkyl amine may be completed in two steps.
